title: Roadmap and Decisions screens, read-only
lead: The two read-only screens for one project, and Decisions across all.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** any edit to the roadmap or decisions (after v1, `ui.slicer-tui`).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The owner sees each project's roadmap and its decisions made and pending
(PROJECT.md goal 1); editing waits for after v1 (`scope.v1`).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/tui/roadmap.go`, `internal/tui/decisions.go` and their tests.
- `testdata/golden/`: the two screens.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- Roadmap lists items in slicer's order with readiness, status, size,
  effort and claim; selecting one loads `show ID --json --lean` into the
  detail pane, pending until it returns.
- Goals from `goals --json` head the screen; a goals error shows verbatim
  without hiding the list (slicer s380).
- Decisions lists open records first with options and recommendation; a
  second tab lists decided records; an "all projects" toggle merges every
  project with `adj: true`, each row naming its project.
- A project with `adj: false` shows "no adj in this project".
- No key on either screen writes anything.
- Golden views at 100x30, colour and monochrome.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
- Reuse S11's polling, pending and error rows.
- Keys are proposed in the help screen; Enter opens detail, Esc returns.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `go test ./...`, `go vet ./...`, `gofmt -l .` clean.
- [HUMAN CHECK] The owner opens both screens on slicer and adjudicate.
- `slicer check` and `adj lint` pass.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit: "S12: Roadmap and Decisions screens, read-only".
